title: Fixed Offset Port Periscope
description: One original complete fixed handheld-periscope appearance: an unbroken hollow vertical rectangular case joins an upper forward mouth to a lower rearward mouth, at different heights and opposite directions. Both rims have real apertures, with open interior depth; complete side carrying bow and grip. All geometry newly authored, no telescope or rangefinder imported, three opaque PBR materials, metre units, Z-up and centred ground origin. Static game-art observer prop only: no optical alignment, mirrors, magnification, observation capability, range, manufacture, protective or safety performance is claimed.
